title: The Biologic Character of Donor Corneal Endothelial Cells Influences Endothelial Cell Density Post Successful Corneal Transplantation

notes: Prospective cohort (2014-2016), single surgeon, 68 consecutive DSAEK or PK patients with 36-month follow-up; the cohort is defined as successful transplants and no graft failure occurred, so values are conditional on graft survival.

Maturity groups come from FACS of cultured donor rim cells (a donor-tissue characteristic, split at the top quartile, middle half and bottom quartile of donors), not from a postoperative outcome; recorded as control condition subgroups.

The DSAEK subgroup size per maturity group is not printed in Table 2; n is the sum of the Table 1 'DSAEK' and 'DSAEK+IOL' counts (tbl1 R27, R28), which totals 36 DSAEK eyes, matching the 52.9% DSAEK share in the abstract.
Postoperative ECD measured every 6 months with a non-contact specular microscope (EM-3000); who measured the donor ECD is not stated.
The Results text gives one low-maturity overall value that differs from Table 2 (outside the extracted DSAEK rows); the table is the cited source.
